OP_citation_and_form: DB iii 14 xšaçapāvā (x-š-ç-p-a-v-a), Dādaršiš satrap of Bactria; DB iii 56 xšaçapāvā, Vivāna satrap of Arachosia [ARIo Q007134 "Darius I 01"; Kent DB 3.14]. Median *xšaθrapāvan- not attested; but Median θr is attested inside the OP corpus in the Median name Xšaθrita (DB ii 15, iv 19; DBe 6), vs Persian ç in xšaça- (29x) and xšaçapāvan- (2x)
other_Achaemenid_period_attestation_(ver: Aramaic: NOT attested in the Elephantine/Arshama data. The Elephantine Aramaic version of Bisitun (TAD C2.1; ERC 306603; copy c. 421 BCE) gives פחתא pḥtʾ "the governor" in both satrap passages: col.7 l.38 "ldddrš šmh ʿlymy prsy pḥtʾ zy bḥtry" (= DB iii 14) and col.8 l.59 "lwymn šmh ʿlymʾ zyly prsy pḥtʾ zy bhrwḥty" (= DB iii 56)
later_or_other_attestation: Akkadian {lu₂}ah₂-ša₂-da-ra-pa₂-an-nu (ahšadrapannu), HBTIN BRM 2, 56 = YOS 20, 71 (MLC 2173) rev. 2, Uruk, SE 144 = 168/7 BCE (post-Achaemenid)
phonology_note_(OP/Median_vs_Middle_Pers: ʾ-ḥ-š-d-r-p-n = prothetic ʾ + xš- + θr (written dr) + -pān: keeps initial xš- and the θr cluster (Median type); Persian has ç (xšaçapāvan-). Same shape as the Akkadian loan aḫ-šadra-pann- (also without -v-). Not the Middle Persian shape (which lost x- and has hr).
unverified_items: Achaemenid-period Akkadian attestations of ahšadrapannu (none in Prosobab titles or in ORACC); Elamite (Persepolis) form; MP šahrab/šahr- (from memory)
